display.purpose: DIP; Viewbox may shrink to fit.

narrative.overview: 沿用 Windows 桌面操作习惯，以清晰的数据行、可区分的双时长和轻量导航呈现应用使用。应用额度、全天分布、本地分析、临时使用与可选邮件延续同一视觉系统；0.7 增加应用搜索、记录日跳转、常用临时分钟、今日全部静默和历史备份归档，0.7.1 增加应用占比与秒级图表详情、键盘专属焦点和自身资源栏，0.8 增加独立的连续用机休息提醒。用户可以独立选择明暗模式、材质和强调色；默认首次跟随系统并使用液态玻璃，之后恢复已保存的选择。界面使用简体中文。
keyCharacteristics: Separate foreground and without-idle durations
Persist independent mode/material/accent choices
Theme tokens computed from user color and mode
Internal translucent material without desktop sampling
Six native WPF destinations with independent navigation scrolling and fixed bottom resources/theme controls
Application limits remind without closing or blocking applications
Local 7/30-day analysis with optional manually approved aggregate sharing
Shared cached local application icons alongside names, including time slices
Separate option-led AI configuration dialog; internal fixed prompt
Recorded-day calendar markers independent of selected-day state
Full-day chart coverage including idle, interruptions, gaps and future
Persisted 200/72 DIP sidebar and native chart selection
Overview wheel scrolling with complete accessible application lists
Per-level reminder sound and effect previews; local short PCM WAV imports
Same-level repeat-entry reminders with per-rule opt-out, visit deduplication and TraceTime-window exclusion
Current acknowledgement separate from today's local-and-email dismissal
Advance 1–120-minute foreground allowances with 5/10/15/30 shortcuts, adjustment, cancellation and same-day restart recovery
Optional SMTP with global and rule switches defaulting off; native 600×740 DIP settings dialog, minimum 480×460, fixed actions and scrolling form
Asynchronous email statuses, manual failure retry and no old-day delivery
Application-name search preserves totals, original ranks, percentage denominators and charts; recorded-day navigation includes idle foreground periods
Optional remembered temporary duration, initially 10 minutes, reused by later reminders
Quiet-today toggle in the existing limits heading and footer marker; covers hidden and new rules without changing their state or stopping timing
Native history backup, month archive and range-replacement restore with preview, safety backup and separate post-commit cleanup feedback
Keyboard-only button focus; mouse selection retains the selected background
Native application-share pie with dual metrics, top-five-plus-other grouping and exact-second hover/keyboard details
Current-process CPU and working-set indicators every two seconds; suspend sampling while hidden or minimized
Optional break reminders default off, initially 30 minutes and medium intensity, with 20/30/45/60/90 presets and explicit 5–240-minute save
Continuous use spans applications and input inactivity; pause/maintenance preserve the round and unknown gaps prove neither use nor rest
Manual rest or known lock/sleep of five minutes resets the round; startup begins at zero without offline backfill
Break-only per-level audio and isolated previews; light notifications repeat at the selected interval, popup snooze counts five more use minutes
Break and application popups do not overlap; global quiet also covers breaks, and disable/quiet/manual rest stop active and pending audio

rules.name: Selected label contrast
rules.body: Choice selected labels use Ink on AccentSoft; Accent remains the border. Verify the actual control combination, not just Accent on Surface.

rules.name: Material scope
rules.body: Glass gradients and opacity are computed in ThemeManager.Apply; soft/minimal surfaces are opaque. No custom shadow tokens exist.

dos: Use DynamicResource for runtime theme colors
Retain native Windows focus and scrolling
Preserve the original user accent in stored preferences
Keep both duration metrics explicit in charts, limits and summaries
Require preview, consent and a send action for optional AI requests; support cancellation
Document native WPF components and DIP dimensions without invented HTML/CSS snippets
Explain that temporary use consumes foreground time including idle, pauses in background/lock/tracking pause, ends at local midnight and reminds even below the daily limit
Require explicit global and rule email enablement, STARTTLS and current-user DPAPI; changing sending service or account requires credentials again
Keep archived history by default; confirm ended-month removal separately after archive validation and locking
Preview and hash-bind restoration, create a safety backup, replace the range transactionally and distinguish success from cleanup warnings
将休息提醒默认关闭、独立配置与音效、明确保存和本轮状态呈现清楚；六项导航可滚动，资源与主题操作固定底部。
donts: Do not treat idle as proof of not working
Do not record titles, URLs, document names, keystrokes or screenshots
Do not describe the material as desktop backdrop sampling
Do not close or block target applications or apply AI suggestions as limit rules
Do not include keys, paths or raw time segments in AI preview data or exports
Do not equate current acknowledgement with dismissal for the whole day
Do not send paths, raw slices or screen contents in reminder email, support implicit TLS on port 465, or claim SMTP acceptance guarantees inbox delivery
Do not include rules, appearance, preferences or credentials in history archives; clearly disclose historical executable paths and unencrypted storage
Do not report original history retained after a committed restore merely because temporary-file cleanup failed
不要将无键鼠输入或未知空档当成已经休息，也不要将休息文案写成治疗或预防效果承诺。
